name: ret_1m
definition: log(c_j / c_{j-1}); bar 0 uses log(c_0/o_0)

name: ret_{5,15,30,60}m
definition: log(c_j / c_{j-k}); NaN until k bars into the session (no overnight mixing)

name: ret_since_open
definition: log(c_j / o_0) where o_0 is the 09:30 bar open

name: true_range_1m[_bps]
definition: max(h_j, c_{j-1}) - min(l_j, c_{j-1}) (bps: / c_j)

name: atr14_1m[_bps]
definition: Wilder ATR(14) of 1-min true range, reset each session

name: rv_30m / rv_30m_ann
definition: sqrt(sum of squared 1-min log returns over last 30 bars); ann. x sqrt(252*390/30)

name: atr14_d / atr14_d_pct
definition: Wilder ATR(14) of daily true range (RTH high/low vs prior official close) through day d-1

name: rv20_d_ann
definition: stdev of 20 prior daily close-to-close log returns x sqrt(252)

name: vwap
definition: session VWAP from 09:30: cumsum(vw*v)/cumsum(v) over bars 0..j (bar vw = bar VWAP)

name: vwap_sd, vwap_up{1,2,3}, vwap_dn{1,2,3}
definition: volume-weighted stdev of bar vw around VWAP; bands = vwap +/- k*sd

name: dist_vwap_bps / dist_vwap_sd
definition: (c_j/vwap_j - 1)*1e4 ; (c_j - vwap_j)/vwap_sd_j

name: vwap_cross_count
definition: cumulative number of sign changes of (c - vwap) since the open

name: or{5,15,30}_high/low/size_bps
definition: high/low of the first N regular-session bars; NaN before bar N-1 closes

name: pm_high / pm_low / pm_volume / pm_ret
definition: pre-market 04:00-09:29 ET high, low, volume, last/prior-official-close - 1

name: pd_high / pd_low / pd_close
definition: prior session RTH high/low (from minute bars) and prior OFFICIAL close (daily bar)

name: gap / gap_atr / flag_large_gap
definition: o_0/pd_close - 1 ; (o_0 - pd_close)/atr14_d ; |gap| > 1 ATR

name: dist_pd_high_bps / dist_pd_low_bps
definition: (c_j / pd_high - 1)*1e4 etc.

name: ret_since_prev_close
definition: c_j / pd_close - 1 (simple return since last official close)

name: cum_volume
definition: cumulative RTH volume through bar j

name: rvol_tod
definition: cum_volume_j / mean(cum_volume at the same bar over the prior 20 sessions)

name: cumvol_share
definition: cum_volume_j / mean(total RTH volume of prior 20 sessions)

name: rvol_1m
definition: v_j / mean(v at the same bar over prior 20 sessions)

name: ema9_1m / ema21_1m / ema_diff_1m_bps
definition: EMA(9)/EMA(21) of 1-min closes (session reset); diff in bps

name: ema9_5m / ema21_5m / ema_diff_5m_bps
definition: EMAs of 5-min closes, updated when each 5-min bar completes, held in between

name: {SOXX,NVDA,QQQ,SMH}_ret_1m[_lag1,_lag2]
definition: driver 1-min log return (and lagged by 1/2 bars) on the same minute grid

name: {driver}_ret_5m / {driver}_ret_since_prev_close
definition: driver 5-min log return ; driver c_j / prior official close - 1

name: idx_ret_since_prev_close
definition: index-proxy (SOXX for SOXL/SOXS) return since its prior official close = r

name: lev_implied
definition: L(1+r)/(1+L*r): exposure/NAV of a daily-reset L-x fund after index move r (L=+3 SOXL, -3 SOXS)

name: tracking_gap_bps
definition: (ret_since_prev_close - L*r)*1e4: deviation from L x proxy move since the close

name: lev_realized
definition: ret_since_prev_close / r when |r| > 0.25%

name: soxl_soxs_div_bps
definition: (SOXL ret since prior close + SOXS ret since prior close)*1e4 (0 under perfect tracking)

name: soxl_soxs_ret1m_sum_bps
definition: (SOXL 1-min log ret + SOXS 1-min log ret)*1e4

name: minute_of_session / minutes_to_close
definition: bar index j (0 = 09:30) ; session bars remaining (half-days end 13:00)

name: dow
definition: day of week (0 = Monday)

name: flag_is_half_day, flag_pre_holiday, flag_post_holiday
definition: early close (13:00) ; next / previous weekday is a market holiday

name: flag_month_end, flag_month_start, flag_quarter_end
definition: last / first trading day of month ; last trading day of quarter

name: flag_monthly_opex, flag_quad_witching
definition: 3rd Friday (or prior trading day) ; same in Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec

name: flag_split, flag_exdiv
definition: split execution date / ex-dividend date of the ticker (from /v3/reference)

name: label_fwd_ret_1m / label_fwd_ret_5m / label_fwd_ret_to_close
definition: FUTURE log returns c_{j+k}/c_j - research labels only
